repository_path.description: The root directory of the syrep repository to manage.

ignore_origin.description: Disable warning about non-matching origin snapshots (--ignore-origin).

progress.description: Show a rotating dash while executing operations (-p / --progress).

snapshot_name.description: The snapshot file to use instead of the default one in the repository (--snapshot=STRING).

cache_file.description: The message digest cache file to use (--cache=STRING).

no_cache.description: Don't use a message digest cache (--no-cache).

no_purge.description: Don't purge obsolete entries from cache after update run (--no-purge).

ro_cache.description: Use cache in a read only fashion (--ro-cache).

check_dev.description: Store information about the device where the file resides (--check-dev).

question.description: Ask a question before each action during merge (-q / --question).

check_md.description: Check message digests of files before deleting or replacing them (--check-md).

always_copy.description: Always copy files instead of hard linking (--always-copy).

output_file.description: Write patch output to specified file instead of STDOUT (--output-file=STRING).

include_all.description: Include files in patch which do exist on the other side under a different name (--include-all).

remember_days.description: Information about how many days in the past should be kept (--remember=DAYS).
